1: // Simple Orbit Dodger game
2: // Canvas with id="game" must exist in the page.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // Full‑screen canvas
8:   const resize = () => {
9:     canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
10:     canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
11:   };
12:   resize();
13:   window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
14: 
15:   const center = () => ({ x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 });
16: 
17:   // Ship state
18:   const ship = {
19:     angle: 0,          // radians
20:     radius: 120,        // distance from centre
21:     angularVel: 0,      // rad/s
22:     fuel: 100,
23:     size: 8,
24:   };
25: 
26:   // Obstacles
27:   const obstacles = [];
28:   const maxObstacles = 30;
29:   const spawnInterval = 1500; // ms
30:   let lastSpawn = 0;
31: 
32:   // Game state
33:   let score = 0;
34:   let startTime = null;
35:   let gameOver = false;
36: 
37:   // Input handling (thrust changes angular velocity)
38:   const keys = {};
39:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => (keys[e.code] = true));
40:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
41: 
42:   const update = dt => {
43:     if (gameOver) return;
44:     // fuel consumption
45:     if (ship.fuel > 0) {
46:       if (keys['ArrowUp']) {
47:         ship.angularVel += 0.0008 * dt;
48:         ship.fuel -= 0.02 * dt;
49:       }
50:       if (keys['ArrowDown']) {
51:         ship.angularVel -= 0.0008 * dt;
52:         ship.fuel -= 0.02 * dt;
53:       }
54:     }
55:     // natural drag
56:     ship.angularVel *= 0.9995;
57:     ship.angle += ship.angularVel * dt;
58:     // keep radius constant (orbit), could add radial thrust later
59: 
60:     // Spawn obstacles
61:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval && obstacles.length < maxObstacles) {
62:       const ang = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
63:       obstacles.push({ angle: ang, radius: Math.max(canvas.width, canvas.height), speed: 0.04 + Math.random() * 0.06, size: 6 + Math.random() * 4 });
64:       lastSpawn = Date.now();
65:     }
66:     // Update obstacles (move inward)
67:     for (let i = obstacles.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
68:       const o = obstacles[i];
69:       o.radius -= o.speed * dt;
70:       if (o.radius < 0) obstacles.splice(i, 1);
71:     }
72:     // Collision detection
73:     const shipPos = polarToCart(ship.radius, ship.angle);
74:     for (const o of obstacles) {
75:       const pos = polarToCart(o.radius, o.angle);
76:       const dx = shipPos.x - pos.x;
77:       const dy = shipPos.y - pos.y;
78:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
79:       if (dist < ship.size + o.size) {
80:         gameOver = true;
81:         break;
82:       }
83:     }
84:     // Update score
85:     score = ((Date.now() - startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
86:   };
87: 
88:   const polarToCart = (r, a) => {
89:     const { x, y } = center();
90:     return { x: x + r * Math.cos(a), y: y + r * Math.sin(a) };
91:   };
92: 
93:   const draw = () => {
94:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
95:     const { x, y } = center();
96:     // planet
97:     ctx.fillStyle = '#222';
98:     ctx.beginPath();
99:     ctx.arc(x, y, 30, 0, Math.PI * 2);
100:     ctx.fill();
101:     // ship (triangle pointing forward)
102:     const shipPos = polarToCart(ship.radius, ship.angle);
103:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
104:     ctx.save();
105:     ctx.translate(shipPos.x, shipPos.y);
106:     ctx.rotate(ship.angle);
107:     ctx.beginPath();
108:     ctx.moveTo(ship.size, 0);
109:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.size, ship.size / 2);
110:     ctx.lineTo(-ship.size, -ship.size / 2);
111:     ctx.closePath();
112:     ctx.fill();
113:     ctx.restore();
114:     // obstacles
115:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f44';
116:     for (const o of obstacles) {
117:       const pos = polarToCart(o.radius, o.angle);
118:       ctx.beginPath();
119:       ctx.arc(pos.x, pos.y, o.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
120:       ctx.fill();
121:     }
122:     // HUD
123:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
124:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
125:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}s Fuel: ${Math.max(0, ship.fuel).toFixed(0)}`, 10, 20);
126:     if (gameOver) {
127:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
128:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
129:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
130:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
131:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
132:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
133:       ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';
134:       ctx.fillText(`Survived ${score}s`, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2 + 40);
135:     }
136:   };
137: 
138:   let lastTime = performance.now();
139:   const loop = now => {
140:     const dt = now - lastTime;
141:     lastTime = now;
142:     if (!startTime) startTime = Date.now();
143:     update(dt);
144:     draw();
145:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
146:   };
147:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
148: })();

(End of file - total 148 lines)
</content>
